en.title: Maximum Optional Tasks Alongside Daily Mandatory Tasks
en.description:
There are n mandatory tasks and n optional tasks, and each task can be done at most once. Each day exactly one mandatory task is scheduled, plus at most one optional task, and their total duration must not exceed H. Find the maximum number of optional tasks completed in n days.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n H, the second line the mandatory durations, and the third line the optional durations. 1≤n,H≤200000; all durations are in 1..H.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The answers are 2, 2 and 0; a total exactly equal to the daily limit can be scheduled.
hints: Turn each mandatory task into a remaining capacity H−duration. Sort the capacities and the optional durations in ascending order, and match the current smallest optional task with the smallest capacity that can hold it.
